name: What is the typical cost to remodel a bathroom in Denver?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to remodel a bathroom in Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom remodeling costs in Denver vary significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the size of the bathroom. A minor remodel, such as updating fixtures and painting, might range from $5,000 to $15,000. A mid-range remodel, including new flooring, vanity, and shower, could be $15,000 to $35,000. High-end or complete renovations, involving reconfiguring the layout or luxury materials, can exceed $35,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to assess your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical bathroom remodeling costs in Denver range from $5,000 for minor updates to over $35,000 for complete renovations, depending on scope and materials.
